author: sergio avila
text:
I have to admit this is the first company of its kind I have seen a service tech show up to a residence and show unprofessionalism. This morning we had a Gentleman show up, checked under our sink for water Leakage took him no more than four minutes said he will step outside and make a phone call and let me know what’s the next step. After freeing my schedule for the day I am sitting inside twiddling my thumbs for approximately 45 minutes. Getting frustrated wondering what’s going on I walked outside and noticed the gentleman is nowhere to be seen. This is very disgusting to have a client just sitting around twiddling their thumbs expecting you to be back with some type of communication. This is not a company that is professional enough to handle a job unless you stay home for a living and you have time to.
This is the reply to the owners review. Spoke to office management. They said he had an emergency call so he had to head out. It wasn’t that he was trained or not so these excuses to justify this wrongdoing or unacceptable.  To tell the customer they will be right back and leave the front door open and to take off in their vehicle without notifying a customer is unprofessional.

author: sally wdog
text: Initially, I had a frustrating experience with Drain Patrol. They repeatedly rescheduled and failed to show up for a water leak repair, promising calls 30 minutes before arrival and then canceling with excuses like being "too busy" or needing a "special technician." It was inconvenient, as I took time off work. After posting my original review, the owner personally apologized, and they promptly sent a technician the next day who fixed the leaking pipe in the wall professionally. I appreciate their effort to make it right, and I’m open to using them again in the future.

author: Rob McQuade
text:
I've been working with Drain Patrol for 6+ years. As a property manager, I really appreciate how responsive Sarah and the whole Drain Patrol team is (whether I'm calling or emailing them). There are a few particular technicians like Ricky that I know I can always count on and ask for by name. My residents appreciate the great direct communication they get, and I know that once it gets handed off to Drain Patrol I'm not going to have to worry about it.

I understand that sometimes things don't go quite as planned. Of the dozens of times I've had Drain Patrol out, there have been a handful when a newer technician was dispatched to take care of an issue and they didn't have the experience necessary. When that has happened, I've reached out and Sarah has gotten things taken care of as quickly as possible. I'm very blunt in my feedback when there's an issue and Sarah takes that feedback without making excuses which is why I continue to work with the team.

Nobody at Drain Patrol asked me to post this review, I just figured it was time since they've been taking care of my plumbing needs for so long.

author: Kendall Deakin
text: Ray from Drain Patrol provided outstanding service at our home  on Gresham St. After living here for nearly a year, our shower drain and sink had been draining poorly—likely due to buildup over the years. Ray fixed everything perfectly, and now the drains work flawlessly. He was not only skilled but also friendly and funny, making the whole experience enjoyable. Thank you so much for your help!
